description: Bibliotheek van cinematische camerabewegingen voor de Veo prompt-pipeline. 'motion_intensity' geeft aan hoe sterk de beweging is; high-moves kunnen botsen met frame-chaining/morphing (zie veo-endframe-en-refs memo).

moves.name: Slow Dolly In
moves.camera: SLOW DOLLY IN (PUSH). The camera glides forward on a track toward the subject, subtly expanding background perspective and enhancing spatial depth.
moves.example_prompt: A slow dolly-in toward a solitary character seated at a kitchen table at dusk, warm window light behind them, the room gradually expanding in depth as the camera moves closer, emphasizing their quiet emotional shift.

moves.name: Slow Dolly Out
moves.camera: SLOW DOLLY OUT (PULL). The camera smoothly tracks backward from the subject, reducing their screen presence while progressively unveiling the surrounding environment.
moves.example_prompt: A lone astronaut stands motionless on a barren alien plain at dusk as the camera performs a slow dolly out, gradually revealing the vast, desolate landscape under a fading purple sky.

moves.name: Fast Dolly In (Rush)
moves.camera: FAST DOLLY IN / RUSH. The camera surges forward toward the subject's face, compressing space to trigger immediate urgency.
moves.example_prompt: FAST DOLLY IN / RUSH on a determined detective as sirens echo in a narrow, rain-soaked alley at night, neon reflections flickering across wet pavement.

moves.name: Vertigo Effect (Dolly Zoom)
moves.camera: DOLLY ZOOM. The camera dollies BACK as the lens zooms IN, violently distorting perspective while locking the subject's scale.
moves.example_prompt: Dolly zoom (zolly): the camera moves backward while zooming in, violently warping and compressing the background. The subject stays the same size in frame despite extreme perspective distortion. A person frozen in fear, standing perfectly still, cinematic and tense.

moves.name: Macro Zoom
moves.camera: Extreme macro zoom from face to microscopic-beginning as an intimate portrait, pushing through skin and iris into abstract cellular structures inside the eye.
moves.example_prompt: A human eye staring unblinking directly into the camera.

moves.name: Hyper Zoom
moves.camera: COSMIC HYPER-ZOOM (ORBIT TO STREET) A single, unbroken zoom races from Earth in deep space, through clouds and city blocks, and lands smoothly on a bustling cafe terrace.
moves.example_prompt: COSMIC HYPER-ZOOM (ORBIT TO STREET) A single, unbroken zoom races from Earth in deep space, through clouds and city blocks, and lands smoothly on a bustling cafe terrace.

moves.name: Over-The-Shoulder (OTS)
moves.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot; camera placed just behind a secondary figure's shoulder (soft focus foreground), framing the primary subject.
moves.example_prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot from a blurred detective's shoulder, framing a suspect under harsh interrogation lights in a dim police interview room, cinematic contrast, shallow depth of field.

moves.name: Fisheye / Peephole
moves.camera: FISHEYE LENS. Ultra-wide distortion with pronounced center bulge. Mimics peephole or security-camera perspective.
moves.example_prompt: A fisheye lens view of a nervous man standing alone in a dim apartment hallway, walls curving unnaturally toward the edges, harsh overhead light, security-camera mood, cinematic tension, realistic lighting, shallow grime on the lens.

moves.name: Reveal From Behind (Wipe)
moves.camera: LATERAL WIPE REVEAL. The frame begins fully obscured by a foreground element (wall, pillar, doorframe) and slides sideways to unveil the concealed subject.
moves.example_prompt: Cinematic lateral wipe reveal from behind a concrete pillar, sliding sideways to reveal a person leaning against a wall, half-hidden and waiting, inside a stark parking garage with thick pillars and harsh overhead lights.

moves.name: Through Shot (Fly-Through Aperture)
moves.camera: FLY THROUGH. The camera glides through a narrow opening or window to unveil the subject beyond.
moves.example_prompt: Cinematic fly-through as the camera passes through a narrow window into a sunlit courtyard, revealing a calm woman standing centered in the distance.

moves.name: Reveal from Blur (Fade In)
moves.camera: FOCUS-PULL REVEAL. Shot opens fully defocused with soft bokeh; the lens smoothly pulls focus until the subject snaps into crisp clarity.
moves.example_prompt: Cinematic focus pull reveals from full bokeh to sharp focus on a man seated alone with an unreadable expression inside a nighttime cafe, circular bokeh lights glowing in the background, shallow depth of field, moody cinematic lighting.

moves.name: Rack Focus (Foreground to Background)
moves.camera: Rack focus: the shot opens with the foreground in crisp focus and a soft background; mid-shot, focus pulls smoothly as the foreground blurs and the background snaps sharp.
moves.example_prompt: A cinematic rack focus shot: a glass of water in sharp focus in the foreground while a tense dining-table conversation blurs behind, then the focus shifts to the background as the glass softens.

moves.name: Tilt Up
moves.camera: SLOW TILT UP. The camera rises vertically on a locked axis, framing boots first and finishing on the face.
moves.example_prompt: A cinematic slow tilt-up shot from polished boots to the face of a sharply dressed, confident figure standing on an urban street with towering buildings behind them.

moves.name: Tilt Down
moves.camera: SLOW TILT DOWN. The camera descends on a fixed axis, starting at the face and revealing the outfit to the boots.
moves.example_prompt: A fashion model holds eye contact in a minimalist studio as the camera slowly tilts down from face to boots.

moves.name: Lateral Truck Left
moves.camera: TRUCK LEFT - Camera glides laterally left on a dolly track, creating pronounced parallax between foreground and background.
moves.example_prompt: Camera trucks left with strong parallax as a woman looks out from a balcony over a layered cityscape at sunset, bathed in warm cinematic light.

moves.name: Lateral Truck Right
moves.camera: TRUCK RIGHT. The camera slides laterally right on track, creating pronounced parallax.
moves.example_prompt: Camera trucks right with strong parallax. A woman looks out from a balcony over a layered cityscape at sunset, cinematic depth and motion.

moves.name: Orbit 180 (Half Circle)
moves.camera: HALF ORBIT. The camera moves on a smooth curved path 180 degrees around the subject, transitioning from frontal profile to rear view.
moves.example_prompt: A cinematic half-orbit shot: the camera moves 180 degrees around a lone man with his head slightly bowed, transitioning from front to back, set in an endless open desert plain.

moves.name: Fast 360 Orbit (Spin)
moves.camera: FAST 360 ORBIT - the camera whips in a full circular path around the subject, causing the environment to streak and spin.
moves.example_prompt: Fast 360 orbit around a fighter standing firm in a circular arena as lights blur into streaks.

moves.name: Slow Cinematic Arc
moves.camera: Slow arc shot; the camera glides in a gentle, wide curve around the subject, gradually revealing her side profile.
moves.example_prompt: Slow arc shot of a contemplative woman gazing off-camera in a quiet forest clearing with soft backlight.

moves.name: Pedestal Down
moves.camera: PEDESTAL DOWN. The camera body lowers vertically from eye level to waist level in a smooth, controlled descent.
moves.example_prompt: Pedestal down on a standing figure exhaling slowly inside a modern office with clean vertical lines.

moves.name: Pedestal Up
moves.camera: PEDESTAL UP. The camera body rises vertically from waist level to eye level, creating a clear shift in perspective.
moves.example_prompt: Pedestal up on a person rising emotionally amid a crowded street as the environment opens up.

moves.name: Crane Up (High Angle Reveal)
moves.camera: CRANE UP. The camera rises and pulls back on a jib, finishing in a high-angle overhead view.
moves.example_prompt: Crane up from a couple standing together as a vast beach unfolds beneath them.

moves.name: Crane Down (Landing)
moves.camera: CRANE DOWN. The camera glides smoothly from a bird's-eye view to the subject's eye level.
moves.example_prompt: Crane down onto a lone traveler waiting in a wide city plaza that narrows into focus.

moves.name: Smooth Optical Zoom In
moves.camera: Smooth optical zoom-in with a locked-off camera; only the lens advances in focal length, compressing depth as soft bokeh blooms and the face gradually dominates the frame.
moves.example_prompt: Smooth optical zoom-in on a calm face as it slowly fills the frame inside a softly lit interior with blurred background highlights.

moves.name: Smooth Optical Zoom Out
moves.camera: Smooth optical zoom-out from a fixed camera position; the lens pulls wider, expanding spatial context while keeping the subject centered and stable.
moves.example_prompt: Smooth optical zoom-out from a centered seated person as a wide room is gradually revealed around them.

moves.name: Snap Zoom (Crash Zoom)
moves.camera: Snap zoom with an instantaneous, aggressive lens punch directly into the subject's eyes, creating a jarring and high-impact framing shift.
moves.example_prompt: Snap zoom straight into a standing woman's eyes mid-realization against a chaotic, frozen background.

moves.name: Drone Flyover (High Altitude)
moves.camera: High-altitude drone flyover, ultra-stable aerial push forward, gliding smoothly above the subject and sweeping across the landscape below.
moves.example_prompt: High-altitude drone flyover of a small group walking through expansive rolling hills bathed in soft morning light.

moves.name: Epic Drone Reveal (Pedestal + Tilt)
moves.camera: Epic drone reveal, starting low behind a mountain ridge, then pedestaling straight up while tilting down to unveil the subject and horizon.
moves.example_prompt: Epic drone reveal rising from behind a mountain ridge to expose a lone figure standing at a cliff edge above a massive valley at sunrise.

moves.name: Large Scale Drone Orbit
moves.camera: Wide-scale drone orbit, a smooth, continuous aerial circle around the subject, maintaining distance to showcase environmental magnitude.
moves.example_prompt: Wide drone orbit circling a central structure within a vast natural landscape, emphasizing immense scale.

moves.name: Top-Down (God's Eye View)
moves.camera: TOP-DOWN DRONE SHOT (GOD'S EYE). Camera locked directly overhead at 90 degrees, slowly rotating.
moves.example_prompt: Top-down rotating drone shot of a lone figure in a flowing red cloak centered in a circular ancient stone plaza with concentric carvings, soft mist, and shifting light.

moves.name: FPV Drone Dive (Aggressive)
moves.camera: FPV DRONE DIVE. Fast, aggressive plunge down a building's facade toward the subject.
moves.example_prompt: Aggressive FPV drone dive racing down tall urban architecture toward a runner reaching the base of the building.

moves.name: Handheld (Documentary Style)
moves.camera: HANDHELD CAMERA with natural micro-jitters, subtle sway, and human 'breathing' drift-intentionally imperfect, never stabilized.
moves.example_prompt: Handheld camera follows a person speaking candidly in a real-world interior with uncontrolled, practical lighting.

moves.name: Whip Pan
moves.camera: WHIP PAN LEFT with aggressive lateral snap and heavy motion blur, masking a rapid transition between focal points.
moves.example_prompt: Whip pan left reveals a new subject across two connected spaces fused by streaking motion blur.

moves.name: Dutch Angle (Roll)
moves.camera: DUTCH ANGLE with a fixed Z-axis roll, tilting the frame so the horizon cuts diagonally through the shot.
moves.example_prompt: Rolled camera frames an emotionally imbalanced character inside a tight, claustrophobic interior.

moves.name: Leading Shot (Backward Tracking)
moves.camera: Backward tracking leading shot, eye-level, stabilized; the camera retreats smoothly at a matched pace to lock the subject in frame.
moves.example_prompt: A determined person strides forward through a long corridor as the camera glides backward, holding constant distance and framing.

moves.name: Following Shot (Forward Tracking)
moves.camera: Forward tracking follow shot, shoulder-height, stabilized; the camera advances behind the subject, matching speed to sustain perspective.
moves.example_prompt: A lone figure walks away down a moody forest path as the camera follows closely from behind.

moves.name: Side Tracking (Parallel)
moves.camera: Side-tracking parallel truck, locked profile, smooth lateral motion matching pace.
moves.example_prompt: Side-tracking camera trucks parallel to a realistic female influencer walking briskly left to right on a photorealistic urban street.

moves.name: POV Walk
moves.camera: First-person POV walk, subtle handheld sway, natural step bob.
moves.example_prompt: First-person POV camera advances with gentle walking sway through a lived-in space, the subject implied by hair, hood edge, or shadow in frame.
